review_notes: arm64 static review: currentASCIIMode uses Swift self x20, per-client InputMode.states with G.setting fallback; currentInputController initialized by swift_unknownObjectWeakInit and loaded through swift_unknownObjectWeakLoadStrong after swift_once token -1; AppDelegate ObjC void action reads this getter, inverts it, and synchronously calls InputMode.changeInputMode. isDefaultASCIIMode(bundleID:) has one return at 0x100360728; replacing its final AND with MOV W0,#1 preserves the function body and forces every newly created session's default to English. x86_64 retained for source identification only, not delivery. System installation at /Library/Input Methods/WeType.app is required by the original main() path check. Real arm64 English-entry session passed idempotent chinese/english and toggle; stop and normal restart restored IPC. Automatic per-app restoration and the force-default patch still require live testing.
